Enrollment: Subjects must have experienced disease recurrence or progression during or after one prior platinum-containing doublet chemotherapy regimen for advanced or metastatic disease.

Subjects who received pemetrexed, bevacizumab, or erlotinib as maintenance therapy (non-progressors with platinum-based doublet chemotherapy) and progressed are eligible. However EGFR wild-type patients who received a tyrosine kinase inhibitor after failure of a prior platinum-based therapy are excluded.

Enrollment: Subjects with active CNS metastases are excluded. Subjects are eligible if CNS metastases are adequately treated and subjects are neurologically returned to baseline (except for residual signs or symptoms related to the CNS treatment) for at least 2 weeks prior to enrollment. In addition, subjects must be either off corticosteroids, or on a stable or decreasing dose of ≤ 10 mg daily prednisone (or equivalent).

Prior therapy with anti-PD-1, anti-PD-L1, anti-PD-L2, anti-CD137, or
anti-CTLA-4 antibody (including ipilimumab or any other antibody or drug specifically targeting T-cell co-stimulation or checkpoint pathways).
